expected_diagnosis: Configured DNS resolver unavailable; IP connectivity appears available.
recommended_next_checks: cat /etc/resolv.conf; nmcli dev show | grep DNS
resolution_guidance: Repair valid DNS resolver settings after checking network policy.
verification: dig resolves using configured resolver; domain request works.
escalate_when: Managed DNS outage or policy-owned resolver.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
